title: Waboba, Gradient Moon Ball

reviews.title: Great gift
reviews.body: Great gift! Kids and adults alike love moon balls. The three pack is a slightly better deal than the regular price. Fun for toddlers to adults. If you have access to a gym, you can really see just how bouncy the moon ball is. My kids love trying to hit the high ceiling of the gym with a powerful bounce.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 30, 2026
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Excellent for reaction training and fun!
reviews.body: The Waboba Moon Ball is fantastic! Right out of the package, you can tell it’s high quality, durable, well-made, and built to last. It works exceptionally well for reaction training, helping improve hand-eye coordination and reflexes. The ball bounces unpredictably in a fun, challenging way, making every catch a little different and keeping your focus sharp.It’s also great just for casual play, indoors or outdoors. Lightweight, easy to throw, and perfect for all ages, this ball combines skill development with pure fun. Highly recommend for athletes, kids, or anyone looking to sharpen their reflexes while having a blast!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on November 23, 2025
reviews.author: Kelsey Slade

reviews.title: Bounciest Bouncy Ball Ever
reviews.body: My son (8) loves these so much that he hounded me to write a review. In his words, "these are super fun, super bouncy, and super entertaining." He also loves the color patterns on the galaxy balls. He has an easy time making the popping sound when bouncing them and the only problem we have is keeping them from bouncing too high. They are about the size of a tennis ball. All in all, good purchase.

reviews.author: Kindle Customer

reviews.title: Good quality
reviews.body: Color is exactly as shown. Seems to be a high quality ball. My kiddo lives it and bounces it off everything. He also plays with it in the pool too and it’s not slippery. Seems to be a fun toy.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 13, 2025
reviews.author: Mandie Jacobs

reviews.title: Not a dog toy, but don't tell my dog!
reviews.body: We discovered by accident that our little Cockapoo loves fetching these kinds of balls in the backyard when he found one in the grandkids' toy chest. We ordered the three pack so we could always find one when he needed one. We had been using the miniature tennis balls but he likes these much better. They make a good thumping sound when they hit the ground or tree so it gives him a good clue on where to look and they bounce in odd ways so it gives him a challenge when he chases them. He did start chewing some pieces off of one of them and we had to throw that one away, but the others are still going strong.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 14, 2024
reviews.author: Barbara A.

reviews.title: Fun but not durable
reviews.body: I've used this indoor, exclusively in a household with no pets. However, the vinyl(?) covering with the design was already starting to peel off after only about an hour of total use. That was disappointing, but the ball is still more fun than any other bouncy ball I've used. The bounce is really high as the name suggests but the slightly irregular shape of it means that it doesn't bounce exactly how you would expect it to which makes it more fun. It's not like one of those reaction balls though which make you chase it all over the place; just slightly unexpected.

reviews.title: Super bouncy minimal effort!!
reviews.body: You need very little effort for a huge bounce. Its big enough to not pose any choking risks and really well made. Its not a super hard ball, but also not squishy. I would really recommend this especially for kids who are too small for small sized bouncy balls or for anyone one who likes a really fun bouncy ball.
